data_fields.name: tracked step range
data_fields.donor_constant: steps 3 to 31 journalled; steps 1 and 2 never gaps

data_fields.name: quest gem drop chance
data_fields.donor_constant: getRandom(100) < 50 (50 percent) while memo state below 3

data_fields.name: daily reset time
data_fields.donor_constant: reset hour and minute from quest config (values not read)

data_fields.name: reward level XP floor
data_fields.donor_constant: XP needed for the reward level (exp table, not read); top-up only when below

best_idea: A quest journal can be a step number plus a list of done steps: a forward jump leaves skipped steps open as gaps, and a rollback clears every step ahead of the one rolled back to.
decision_why: Keep the gap and rollback rules for the quest journal as server data, drop the 31-step bit word, the steps-below-3 exception and the thread-pool timers (defects 2, 3, 5 fixed); reject the reward-on-talk path, which changes state from a read.
acceptance: After a jump from step 2 to step 6 a server test lists steps 3, 4 and 5 as gaps; a rollback to step 4 keeps the gap at step 3 and clears step 6; a kill or talk never grants a reward without a server action.
